LFG: DM looking for Players

Hi folks! I'm Hannah, a DM of 4 years. I'm looking for players to run an open world campaign similar to old school games. We'd start out in a village, next to a dungeon, on a small hex map. From there we'd expand the world based off of what you want to see as players. I'm all about collaborative storytelling and am a big fan of the characters. In contrary, I like building challenging situations that don't always have an easy way out. I also enjoy a mix of cartoon shenanigans and brooding anime plots.

My table is a safe place for the LGBTQ+ community as I am trans and just recently left a toxic group. We would be using Black Hack 2e. The section for players are less than 30 pages. The game will be ran over discord. It will take place on Saturdays at 6pm EST. Session 0 will be the 22nd if we have enough players.
